name: webappbench-extension
description: Chrome extension that applies WebAppBench prompts to AI sitebuilders and collects execution duration and cost.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-static.mjs && node scripts/build-prompts.mjs
scripts.watch: node scripts/copy-static.mjs && node scripts/build-prompts.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json --watch
